issues.title: Maximum recursion depth crash with pyreverse -S
issues.detail: pyreverse -S on a class whose attribute is a numpy array runs past 120 s without producing a diagram; -s2 finishes at once and writes the dot file. The 2020 RecursionError is gone — what is left is the unbounded association walk.

issues.title: pyreverse -c option causes stack overflow
issues.detail: The reporter's MRE — an xr.DataArray subclass inside a package __init__.py, which is what made it recurse — lints clean, no fatal.

issues.title: Maximum recursion depth exceeded importing from panda3d
issues.detail: from panda3d import core resolves with no recursion and no fatal.

issues.title: AstroidError 'Could not find <FunctionDef.warning_logger'
issues.detail: The trigger was haggis monkey-patching logging at import time. With add_trace_level() called before the logger is used, no fatal.

issues.title: StatementMissing: Statement not found on <Module.builtins
issues.detail: A class with a method named after a site builtin (license, copyright, credits, exit, quit) that is also bound as an instance attribute. ancestor.lookup() walks out into Module.builtins, which has no statement.
issues.exc: astroid.exceptions.StatementMissing: Statement not found on <Module.builtins l.0>

issues.title: Crash when using mcculw lib
issues.detail: from mcculw import ul and from mcculw.enums import ULRange both resolve; no recursion, no fatal.

issues.title: Unfound astroid.exceptions.InferenceError causes a crash
issues.detail: Reading .fset off a getter-only @property raises out of the property object model instead of inferring Uninferable.
issues.exc: astroid.exceptions.InferenceError: Unable to find the setter of property p

issues.title: 'Deprecated' object has no attribute '__dict__' with unsafe-load-any-extension
issues.detail: Clean both with default options and with --unsafe-load-any-extension=y, which is the flag the report named.

issues.title: 'UninferableBase' object is not iterable
issues.detail: The reporter's reduced case — LEGACY_JSON_OPTIONS.with_options(...) from bson — lints clean.

issues.title: Colorama >=0.4.5 not only required in Windows environment
issues.detail: The crash was dill failing to pickle the linter through colorama's stream wrapper in a worker. A two-file -j2 run completes with no colorama or dill frame anywhere.

issues.title: RecursionError escapes when calculating MRO
issues.detail: The Django TYPE_CHECKING conditional-base pattern with a methodtools.lru_cache method builds its MRO without recursing.

issues.title: UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode characters
issues.detail: Emulated by forcing a cp1252 stdout on Linux: the reporter's shape — a non-ASCII fixme message reaching the text reporter — writes replacement characters instead of raising. Not a Windows run; only Windows can close this.

issues.title: Crashed while using pylint as a static test for a docker
issues.detail: Rebuilt the reporter's SQLAlchemy declarative model with the two local modules it imports. Messages, no fatal.

issues.title: py313: 'black.parsing.ASTSafetyError' object has no attribute '__dict__'
issues.detail: No fatal. The import now yields E0611 no-name-in-module for black.parsing.InvalidInput — a separate false positive worth its own issue. Reported on macOS + 3.13; this run is Linux + 3.14.

issues.title: Building error creating ast of 'sympy.polys.numberfields.resolvent_lookup'
issues.detail: Importing that one sympy module still blows the stack while astroid builds it. The reporter's own snippet used minio; the module named in their traceback is the actual trigger and reproduces on its own.
issues.exc: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded → astroid.exceptions.AstroidError

issues.title: TypeError: 'UninferableBase' object is not iterable
issues.detail: The file imports the reporter's private ft_core package. Nothing runnable was shared.

issues.title: Infinite recursion error with scipy 1.16
issues.detail: from scipy.special import erf no longer recurses. It now emits E0611 no-name-in-module instead — a separate false positive on a C extension.

issues.title: Building error, possibly caused by win32more
issues.detail: win32more installs on Linux but will not import, so astroid takes a different path than the reporter's. Needs Windows.

issues.title: 'EmptyNode' object has no attribute 'name' in pyreverse
issues.detail: No natural trigger found: pyreverse walks namedtuple subclasses and argparse.Namespace subclasses and writes its dot file. The open PR constructs the EmptyNode by hand in its test, which suggests nobody has one either.

issues.title: Improper handling of log message format bytestrings
issues.detail: A non-UTF-8 bytes format string passed to a logging call is decoded without an error handler.
issues.exc: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xc0 in position 0

issues.title: Astroid crashes on PyPy 3.11: expected str, got getset_descriptor
issues.detail: Ran the reporter's file under PyPy 3.11.15 with astroid 4.3.1: clean. They were on Windows with astroid 4.0.4 / 4.2.0b3, so either the astroid bump fixed it or it is Windows-specific.

issues.title: InferenceError: Inference failed for all members of AssignAttr
issues.detail: A for loop whose target is an attribute on a class that carries a metaclass lookup. typecheck.visit_attribute calls owner.getattr without guarding the metaclass path.
issues.exc: astroid.exceptions.InferenceError: Inference failed for all members of [AssignAttr]

issues.title: Uncaught StatementMissing exception in class checker
issues.detail: The same defect as the entry above it, found by fuzzing: a subclass method named help shadowing an instance attribute of the parent. Shorter than the original report and the better regression test.
issues.exc: astroid.exceptions.StatementMissing: Statement not found on <Module.builtins l.0>
